# Vote India Secure — Shareholder E-Voting Platform

Vote India Secure is an electronic voting platform built for Indian corporate governance. It enables companies, shareholders, scrutinizers, and RTAs to conduct secure online e-voting for AGMs, EGMs, postal ballots, and shareholder resolutions with cryptographic audit trails.

## Core Capabilities
- Remote e-voting for AGMs, EGMs, and postal ballots
- Weighted shareholding ballot calculations
- Cryptographic ballot integrity (AES-256, SHA-256)
- Independent Scrutinizer portal with automated report generation
- Two-Factor OTP authentication
- Real-time quorum progression monitoring
- AI document summarization for meeting notices and annual reports
